title: Systems file
description: A file under data/systems/: a list of operating systems. Cross-references (authors, taxonomy keys, logo files) are checked by `node scripts/validate-data.mjs`.

knownFor.description: Editorial: what it is best known for, 2 to 4 words.

pitch.description: Editorial, optional: one sentence in the "Give me X and I'll Y" voice.

released.description: Year the system (or the project it continues) was first released. Approximate for early or renamed/rebranded projects, like `installs`.

distroBase.description: Key of taxonomy/families.json (the closest distro family, used for the card tag and color) for Linux systems, null otherwise.

by.description: Who makes it: keys of authors.json, primary author first.

basedOn.description: Every upstream it descends from, keys of taxonomy/based-on.json (can be empty). Multiple values are normal: macOS is Darwin and FreeBSD, Ubuntu is Debian.

unix.description: Key of taxonomy/unix-status.json: certified, like or none.

generation.description: Optional key of taxonomy/generations.json (e.g. NT 5 / NT 6 / NT 10) for versioned families.

logo.description: File in assets/logos/; omit for a generated initials tile.

kernel.description: Kernel name with the latest version when it could be confirmed.

defaultShell.description: The default shell first, then alternatives.

userland.description: Core tools / libc: GNU, BusyBox, BSD userland...
